title: The One-Decade Task: Putting std::atomic in CUDA. - Olivier Giroux - CppCon 2019
summary: Olivier Giroux's CppCon 2019 talk recounts the roughly ten-year effort to bring std::atomic and the C++ memory model to CUDA GPUs, through ten stories from that work.
why: Cited as a reference when discussing NVIDIA's C++ memory model, libcu++, and GPU C++ resources.
